tasks.fmt: deno fmt apps/web packages scripts docs .github *.md deno.json
tasks.fmt:check: deno fmt --check apps/web packages scripts docs .github *.md deno.json
tasks.typecheck: deno check packages/protocol/src/mod.ts packages/client-data/src/mod.ts packages/fixtures/src/mod.ts packages/fixtures/src/mock_server.ts apps/web/main.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/routes apps/web/browser apps/web/lib apps/web/scripts scripts
tasks.test:unit: deno test --allow-read=apps/web,packages apps/web/browser/*_test.js apps/web/lib/*_test.ts apps/web/lib/*_test.tsx packages/fixtures/src/mod_test.ts packages/protocol/src/mod_test.ts
tasks.test: deno task test:unit && deno task test:publication
tasks.verify:public: deno run --allow-read=. scripts/publication_guard.ts && deno run --allow-read=. scripts/verify_assets.ts
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task client:check && deno task test
tasks.ci: deno task check && deno task verify:public && deno task build && deno task verify:generated
